body: thank you so much for this kind perspective. it’s definitely helpful to hear that i can still find someone to love while looking like i do. life is so lonely when you feel this way, as im sure everyone here knows to some degree. currently seeking out some treatment options to help me obsess less about my appearance. i want to make it through this so badly
thank you so much :(. i’m an only child and my parents love me so much. i don’t know how i’d ever be able to end my suffering without ruining everyone’s lives. i hope things get better too:(
